thread:
jen: Quick sync: we need final copy and routing for the launch page that pushes webinar signups, trial starts, and demo requests. Goal: clear paths for hosted / dedicated / private. Keep it concise.
marc: Proposed hero lines (short): 1) "Serve LLMs at production scale—fast, predictable, cost-aware." 2) "Same API, any deployment: hosted, reserved, or private VPC." 3) "Ship reliable LLM features without building inference infra." Which resonates more?
rachel: I like 1 for devs, 2 for product pages. Can we make 3 the social headline for launch posts?
tom: Routing idea: single canonical URL /deploy that surfaces content sections by mode and uses querystring to determine CTAs/forms. examples: ?mode=hosted, ?mode=dedicated, ?mode=private.
samira: Webinar: Nov 12, 10am PT  Title: "Benchmarking inference: latency, cost, and scale." Primary CTA on page should be "Register for benchmark webinar" for marketing traffic; for enterprise (?aud=enterprise) flip to "Request an enterprise demo".
jen: Good. Also: capture utm params and a hidden field for account size (est. monthly tokens) and compliance interest checkbox. Those two fields feed lead scoring.
marc: Copy micro-proposals for three inline CTAs: hosted = "Start hosted trial"; dedicated = "Get reserved capacity"; private = "Contact sales for private deployment". Short, action-oriented.
rachel: For launch posts we should have two asset sets: a technical thread highlighting benchmarks + a business thread highlighting SLAs and isolation. Each post links to /deploy?mode=<mode>&utm_source=launchpost&utm_campaign=nov_bench&utm_content=<mode>.
tom: Example routing pseudocode to include in handoff: 
``` 
const mode = params.mode || inferModeFromUTM(params.utm_content);
if (params.aud === 'enterprise' || mode === 'private') sendTo('enterprise_queue');
else if (mode === 'dedicated') sendTo('ae_dedicated');
else sendTo('marketing_self_serve');
```
Make sure email capture includes utm_campaign + mode.
samira: Webinar form fields: name, email, company, role, estimated monthly tokens (dropdown), compliance (checkbox), utm_campaign (hidden), mode (hidden). Add option: "I want a custom demo" which triggers AE outreach.
jen: Marketing ops: generate UTMs matrix and mapping sheet to sales queues. Also create a webhook to push enterprise-level leads to SFDC with priority tag if compliance checked.
marc: Hero A/B poll: react with :a: for "Serve LLMs at production scale..." and :b: for "Same API, any deployment..."
rachel: :a:
jen: :a:
tom: :b: (leaning enterprise)
samira: :a: ok.
marketing-bot: Assets uploaded: https://assets.redwood.com/launch/benchmarks (includes graphs, copy snippets, social cards).
jen: Next tasks: marc finalize hero and CTA text + staging copy; tom wire query-param routing and add tests; rachel prepare launch post threads and schedule; samira build webinar form and email flows; I'll review Friday 11am PT. Keep thread updates short. :sparkles:
